status: SERVED from round 19: flow/burst-v2 and flow/vanish-v2 (flow.js frameSrc and the stage sheet in index.html). The old flow/burst and flow/vanish folders are kept on disk, unreferenced.
alpha: lossless WebP alpha, lossy RGB q80 (-sharp_yuv -m 6), straight alpha

pipeline.source: original mp4, native 1280x720, BT.601 TV range, RGB via ffmpeg default
pipeline.key: greenness gd = G - max(R,B); hard foreground gd<=20; edge band 20<gd<0.9*key; alpha = projection of (C-K) on (F-K); F = mean of nearby hard pixels
pipeline.downscale: premultiplied area average to 440x385; protected pale pixels (antenna, cream) use nearest-neighbour alpha and colour
pipeline.choke: 3x3 minimum (1 px), skipped on protected pixels
pipeline.feather: 3x3 binomial (1 px), skipped on protected pixels
pipeline.despill: G <= max(R,B) everywhere; partial pixels G <= max(R,B)-10
pipeline.colour_extension: colour under alpha 0 extended from the object
pipeline.closed_loop: decode after encode; lower G on flagged partial-alpha edge pixels (and their neighbours) until the decoded edge band has 0 green-dominant pixels (8 rounds max)
